title: Outro: Ego – The Person I Am
story:
In February 2020, BTS released **Map of the Soul: 7**, an album that explored identity, self-reflection, and the different sides of the self. The album's final track, **"Outro: Ego,"** became j-hope's deeply personal reflection on his own journey.

LOOKING BACK ON HIS JOURNEY

The song looks back at the path that brought him here: the choices he made, the challenges he faced, and the moments when his life could have taken a different direction. It also revisits the beginning of BTS's story, musically connecting the outro to the group's very first album through a sample of **"Intro: 2 Cool 4 Skool."**

In a **2021 interview with Rolling Stone**, j-hope explained that the song was about self-reflection: the life of Jung Hoseok as an individual and the life of j-hope as an artist. Looking back at both sides of himself helped him reach an important conclusion: he believes in himself, in who he is, and in the identity he has built. He knows that challenges will continue to come, but he intends to face them and try new things by relying on himself.

EMBRACING EVERY EMOTION

He also spoke about how, in the early years, he had felt the need to show only the bright side of himself and the group, partly because his name is j-hope. But as time passed, he realized that people experience many different emotions. He wanted to express those feelings, too, through music and conversation.

In **2022**, when choosing **"Outro: Ego"** for the **Proof of Inspiration** series, he described it as a song that expresses him as a whole, whether as Jung Hoseok or j-hope. He reflected on the crossroads he had faced and wondered what might have happened if he had chosen a different path. Thinking about those possibilities made him even more grateful for the choices he had made.

ACCEPTING EVERY SIDE OF HIMSELF

He also shared that he had come to accept every side of himself. There were times when he hid parts of who he was, but he learned that those sides were all part of his identity. The acceptance and support of the BTS members and ARMY helped him embrace himself as he is.

"Outro: Ego" is more than a song about looking back. It is about accepting the person you have become, trusting your own choices, and finding the courage to keep moving forward.

Jung Hoseok and j-hope. Different sides of one person. One journey, one identity.
surpriseDescription: A journey through memories, challenges and self-discovery. Revisit “Outro: Ego”, a song that celebrates the path that made j-hope who he is.

challenge.question: How did j-hope describe the meaning of "Outro: Ego" in his 2021 Rolling Stone interview?
options: As a song about becoming famous and achieving success.
As a reflection on the lives of Jung Hoseok and j-hope, and on his identity.
As a song written mainly to express his love for dancing.
challenge.answer: As a reflection on the lives of Jung Hoseok and j-hope, and on his identity.
challenge.explanation: j-hope explained that the song reflects on who he is, both as an individual and as an artist. Through that self-reflection, he came to believe in himself and in his identity.
